name: display-bezel
why: The only part that recesses into a face rather than cutting through one, so it is the only case holding the entry-side overlength down. Take that overlength away and the seat cutter never reaches the front face: `generatedBy: "bezel_seat"` then tracks no edge there and the build fails by name. Stripped of its treatment the same change is silent — 27 faces become 29, the volume rises by exactly the 24.70 mm³ of skin left across three cut ends, and the part stays watertight. See docs/GOTCHAS.md, "A cut needs overlength at both ends".
